other_failure_modes.name: Target encoding leakage in training
other_failure_modes.description: When applying target encoding, the agent computes the mean/std of the target over the training fold and merges it directly back onto the training fold without using leave-one-out or K-fold out-of-fold techniques. This leaks the target value of each row into its own features during training, leading to severe overfitting.

other_failure_modes.name: Ignoring provided relational datasets
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fails to load and join supplementary datasets (such as weather or metadata files) that are explicitly provided for the task and contain crucial predictive features.

summary: The agent's solution has critical flaws related to temporal validation, data completeness, and target leakage. It uses random K-Fold cross validation on time-series data causing look-ahead bias, and applies naive target encoding directly to the training fold which leaks the target into the features. Furthermore, it completely ignores supplementary relational datasets (weather and building metadata) which are essential for this task.
